expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: sessions held in the web servers' memory logged members out
when a request reached the other server and on every deploy, which is why sessions live in Postgres.
expectations.evidence: The agent states: "In 2023 larder moved to two servers behind a load balancer and kept sessions in each server's memory. Members were logged out whenever a request reached the other server, and every deploy logged everyone out." It explains that Postgres was chosen to prevent deploy logouts, warns that an in-process dict restores the failed setup, and asks before changing anything.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/adrs/0001-keep-sessions-in-the-database.md before its first edit.
